d:
"Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Bullish President Stacey Cunningham, OKXICE Co-Chair Andrew Cuomo, Bain Capital Ventures Partner Matt Harris, NYU Faculty & Monarq Asset Management Chief Operating Officer Professor Ayesha Kiani, and Vanderbilt Law School Associate Dean & Professor of Law Yesha Yadav.
